## Profile Summary

Akhil Neelam is a full-time MBA student at the UC Berkeley Haas School of Business pursuing product management and product marketing roles in technology. His work spans AI products, public-sector technology, education technology, civic engagement, and gender equality.

Before business school, Akhil co-founded the Centre for Gender And Politics, a volunteer-led think tank focused on gender inclusion in South Asian politics. The organization grew to 140+ members across 14 countries and built research, publications, and partnerships around women's political leadership.

## Core Themes

- AI and product strategy
- Product management and product marketing
- Social impact and public-sector technology
- Gender equality and civic leadership
- Education technology and learning continuity
- Human-centered product discovery and user research

## Featured Work

- AI-Powered Census Automation: product work at Uniblox, an InsurTech startup, including LLM fine-tuning and NLP pipeline improvements for insurance workflow automation.
- Women Politicians Repository: CGAP and J.P. Morgan platform for aspiring women politicians in South Asia, reaching 10K+ users.
- WhatsApp Learning Bot: product customization and rollout support for a learning bot used during COVID-19 to support 3M students.
- AI-Based Learning Solution: government AI education pilot with vendors, consulting firms, and public departments, with a policy framework for scaling to 500 schools.

## Side Projects

- Daily Newsletter Briefing via Alexa: AI-powered workflow that converts newsletters into short audio summaries for Alexa Flash Briefing.
- CalEvents Discovery: AI search tool for finding UC Berkeley events across department websites.
- MirrorMe: AI virtual try-on Chrome extension for visualizing clothes on a user from the product page.
- starred: privacy-filtered Google Takeout visualization of starred places using React, Three.js, and WebGL.
- Write Like a Human: open-source writing skill for reducing common AI writing tells and calibrating outputs to a specific voice.

## Speaking And Publications

- UN Women Asia-Pacific AI School: steering committee/advisor work on AI for social impact training.
- UN consultations on women's leadership: research and awareness projects influencing consultations.
- G20 and global forums: speaking on AI, gender equality, and technology for social good.
- Selected publications include `Worth Asking: Interviews with Women MPs and Ministers in South Asia`, The Diplomat writing on Sri Lankan politics, and UN Women writing on digital spaces in South Asian politics.

## Education

- MBA, UC Berkeley Haas School of Business, 2025-2027.
- Young India Fellowship, Ashoka University, 2016-2017.
- B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering, SASTRA University, 2012-2016.
